intro: I'm Jikrul Islam Jeto, a web developer and competitive programming enthusiast from Bangladesh. I enjoy turning ideas into practical web applications, solving problems through code, and exploring the technologies behind modern software.
summary: My programming journey began in 2025, when I started learning Python on a mobile phone. What began as curiosity about software, games, and cybersecurity gradually grew into an interest in web development, C++, data structures, algorithms, and competitive programming.
focus: I'm currently most interested in frontend development, especially building responsive interfaces that feel intuitive, clean, and useful. I'm also exploring full-stack development, authentication systems, database integration, and how frontend and backend technologies work together.
approach: I learn through documentation, courses, experimentation, and AI-assisted development. I believe understanding the reasoning behind an implementation matters just as much as getting it to work, so I try to review, test, and improve the solutions I build.

journey.title: Curiosity Turned Into Code
journey.description: Started learning Python on a mobile phone and explored how software, games, and security-related systems work.

journey.title: Discovering Web Development
journey.description: Started exploring HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React to learn how interactive websites and web applications are built.

journey.title: Exploring Computer Science
journey.description: Focused more on C++, data structures, algorithms, and competitive programming while strengthening problem-solving skills.

journey.title: Building Real Projects
journey.description: Developing practical web applications, exploring full-stack technologies, refining frontend skills, and continuing to solve algorithmic problems.

interests.title: Frontend Development
interests.description: Creating responsive, accessible, and visually consistent interfaces that turn ideas into useful experiences.

interests.title: Full-Stack Development
interests.description: Exploring authentication, databases, APIs, and the systems that make web applications work end to end.

interests.title: Competitive Programming
interests.description: Practicing algorithms, analyzing problems, and developing a more structured approach to problem-solving.

interests.title: Cybersecurity
interests.description: Exploring security concepts and learning how software systems can be designed and understood more carefully.

interests.title: Continuous Learning
interests.description: Expanding my knowledge across software engineering, data engineering, computer science, and emerging technologies.

beyondCode: Beyond programming, I'm interested in psychology, history, law, and understanding how people think. I enjoy gaming, observing nature, and photographing the sky and moon. These interests keep me curious and encourage me to look at problems from different perspectives.
career: I'm looking for opportunities to learn, collaborate, and grow through internships, junior developer roles, and meaningful projects. My long-term goal is to become a well-rounded software engineer with strong foundations in development, computer science, and problem-solving.
